title.en: National Investment & Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) vs Special Economic Zones (SEZ)
title.hi: National Investment & Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) vs Special Economic Zones (SEZ)

rows.en: Focus on manufacturing sector growth and employment generation
rows.hi: Focus on manufacturing sector growth and employment generation

rows.en: Focus on export promotion and foreign exchange earnings

rows.en: Both provide world-class infrastructure and single-window clearance mechanisms.

clarification.en: NIMZ is designed for domestic manufacturing and employment, whereas SEZ is primarily focused on export-oriented units.

relationship.en: NIMZ serves as a key infrastructure vehicle to achieve the objectives of the Make in India initiative.
